item.title: Pyaari Azaadi Names a Revolution
item.description: “I think sometimes of that black and white historic photograph of 100 people giving a Nazi salute, except one person,” the artist told Hyperallergic. “I think that’s me.”

item.description: Inspired by Dalí’s vision and his engagement with scientific work, this program seeks to explore the limits of knowledge and imagination through dialogue between art and science.

item.title: The Cruelty of American Curatorial Silence
item.description: Many of my fellow curators, especially at institutions, have failed to speak out against fascism. What is it about being a curator that offers a free pass for political silence?

item.title: Theaster Gates Is Best When He’s Ambiguous
item.description: When Gates opens a gap between how something is perceived and what it is, he does not simply make a connection for the viewer — he invites self-reflection.
